scope: Student symptom navigation reads the current micro-action and fallback, while retaining complete action/role/Stop and no-answer guidance.
New first-use material projects only the4 consumed support fields; teaching fingerprint also binds presentation revision.
Support absent retains v2 fingerprint/format; support present requires v3. Already exported real packets were not rewritten.

tests.command: python -m unittest tests.test_symptom_student_guidance plus4 explicitly selected first-use support tests

actual_cli.command: python -m answer_engine symptom 阅读理解 看不懂长句 --renderer student
actual_cli.readback: Shows current R11 micro-action, complete relevant sentence action, full Stop, fallback, task-evidence request and no answer. Not trigger success on a real question.

limits: Contract/projection and synthetic controls only. No real student, measured timing, full exam regression, source-semantic or publication approval.
